notes.title: Hidden Artifacts found: The Gunk Steam Community Items available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41956830/d39913bb5c38d19966efe944462834841abe2ba2.jpg

To all you adventurers out there,

We hope you all have a good start into the new week! If not we can hopefully help you out a little bit, because the Steam Community Items for The Gunk are now available! 

The Gunk Steam Community Items include:
 5 Emoticons
 5 Profile Backgrounds
 5 Trading Cards
 Badge (5 Levels + Foil Badge)
Thank you once again for all the feedback we continue to receive from you. It's really valuable to us, and we read and analyze everything we get. Promise! ❤️

Over and out!
Image & Form Games

notes.title: The Gunk - Fixes and Improvements Patch (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41956830/f1d42c3ba08c1b94fa01e802ff1ecc108635dd38.jpg
Greetings Adventurers,

We have just released a new update fixing some translation issues, bug fixes, and improved performance. Down below, you can find the full changelog! 

Changelog:
Rani’s name and some special characters are now displayed correctly in the subtitles of some translations.
Fixed some smaller translation issues.
Fixed a bug where the Vibration settings did not update properly.
Fixed a rare crash in the settings menu.
Improved performance.
